name: Weak close → buy the next open, hold to 15:55 — mean-reverting tape only (acr 1–5 min)
why: A weak close forces de-risking (vol-targeting funds, margin, stops); dealers and dip buyers absorb it and the next session mean-reverts, most in fearful (high VIX) regimes where forced selling overshoots. Tape filter pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_tape_filter_all.md).
